_comment: Copy to $HERMES_HOME/field-notes.json (scripts/install.py does it once) and edit. Missing keys fall back to defaults; precedence: CLI flag > FIELDNOTES_* env > this file > default. Keys starting with '_' are ignored.
_comment_store_dir: Where the notes live. Empty = $HERMES_HOME/field-notes. Point several agents (or profiles) at one folder to share a store.
_comment_hermes_root: The hermes-agent checkout the patches are checked against. Empty = $HERMES_HOME/hermes-agent.
_comment_patch_scripts_base: Base folder for relative patch_script paths in patch notes; used only to print the re-apply command. The skill never runs patch scripts.
_comment_drift: Files ignored when listing core changes outside the registry: caches and the backups patch scripts leave next to the files they edit.
_comment_dashboard: One pinned Telegram message, edited in place by the agent's own bot. Off until you enable it. chat_id empty = TELEGRAM_HOME_CHANNEL (+ TELEGRAM_HOME_CHANNEL_THREAD_ID). An explicit chat_id never inherits the home thread: set thread_id for a forum topic. The bot must be an admin with the right to pin messages.
_comment_alerts: How often the same failure (bot errors, missing store) may be repeated. State changes are always reported once.
